n2e0905d773.headline: Buhari backs CBN over old naira deadline amid outcry for extension
n2e0905d773.summary: President Muhammadu Buhari has backed the Central Bank of Nigeria's plan to phase out the 200, 500 and 1,000 naira notes by Tuesday, January 31, despite calls for an extension.
n2e0905d773.why: Changes to banknote validity affect cash liquidity in the economy and the naira's domestic payment system, and the central bank sets monetary and currency policy.
